decisions.reason: Changing the live website implementation stack from Astro to plain HTML plus Tailwind does not alter the landing page's approved visual design choices.
The implementation-stack decision does not change the selected headline font or button color design tokens.
The source decision concerns implementation of the live website landing page, not the independently scoped console shell or its visual style.
The source changes the website coding approach but does not establish, remove, or modify any footer behavior, content, or design.
